tasks.title: Establish weekly competitor intelligence review
tasks.success_criteria: Weekly review reports actionable changes in competitor offers, funnels, pricing, proof, content, and positioning.

tasks.title: Build proof library
tasks.success_criteria: At least 3 problem-based case studies with source evidence for every quantified claim.

tasks.title: Build Federal Pathway Score specification and MVP
tasks.success_criteria: Diagnostic accepts evidence-backed positioning signals and returns pathway status plus three highest-priority actions without treating unverified claims as fact.

tasks.title: Rewrite priority outbound using intelligence-first hooks
tasks.success_criteria: Priority segments map to one of three offers and every first touch contains verified condition, implication, next step, and single CTA.

tasks.title: Create offer landing pages
tasks.success_criteria: One landing page per front-door offer with outcome-led hero, proof, deliverables, CTA, and FAQ.

tasks.title: Update homepage hero and conversion path
tasks.success_criteria: Homepage leads with economic outcome and routes visitors into a diagnostic or relevant offer rather than a broad service menu.

tasks.title: Clean legacy website positioning
tasks.success_criteria: Conflicting legacy business-plan, grant, loan, website, and other non-core positioning is removed, redirected, consolidated, or noindexed.

tasks.title: Launch founder-led authority cadence
tasks.success_criteria: Each week produces 3 short videos, 3 LinkedIn data posts, and 1 intelligence email; each month produces 1 webinar and 1 deep asset.

tasks.title: Add revenue-weighted campaign scorecard
tasks.success_criteria: Campaign decisions use qualified replies, booked meetings, shows, proposals, closes, and revenue per 1000 delivered rather than opens alone.

tasks.title: Build qualified-prospect nurture system
tasks.success_criteria: Interested but not-ready prospects receive useful intelligence/case-study follow-up without being recycled into generic cold sequences.

tasks.title: Feed competitor findings into experiments
tasks.success_criteria: Meaningful competitor changes create a documented copy/test/adopt/avoid decision and, when warranted, a measurable experiment.
